## Bank contributions checklist

- [ ] Board screenshot attached (or the image shown in context)
- [ ] No watermark, no source logo
- [ ] No black bars (letterbox), no burned-in text
- [ ] Landscape — or square only if it's a close-up
- [ ] `concepts` tagged meaningfully (not `misc`)
- [ ] `film` filled in when known

## Rule / method changes

- [ ] Grounded in a real reel, with the anti-example that motivated it
- [ ] `style-rules.md` updated, calibration log entry added if constants changed
